plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Mathematics, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 1720S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/catalog/math-department/mathematics/mathematics-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits). TRUE award: Associate of Science. Total credits: 60, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 60-61'). DISCREPANCY NOTED HONESTLY: the official page prints 'Total Credit Hours: 16' for Fall Semester Sophomore Year, but the official course credits listed in that table (MATH 275 4 + MATH 176 4 + COMM GE 3 + COMS 229 4 + COMS 229L 0) sum to 15. Transcribed per the official course credits (semester sums to 15); the catalog's overall 60-61 total still holds (15+15+15+15=60 minimum with SCIG GE2 at 3 cr; 61 maximum with SCIG GE2 at 4 cr). COMS 229L is a required 0-credit corequisite lab, modeled with required_zero=true per validator convention. Choice slots: SCIG GE / HUMA GE1 / WELL GE / SOCS GE / COMM GE / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE2 / SCIG GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice). SCIG GE2 is '3-4 Credits'; modeled here as 3 SCH for the 60-credit minimum path. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page. Footnotes: Humanities, Social Science, and Science courses must each be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
